name: Just Enough Items
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: mezz

softOff.why: @wrap-operation into the game's classes; registers blocks, items or entities (they stay, inert); runs threads of its own; has network channels

works: Its item list, search box (with the keyboard, copy and paste), tooltips, clicks, R and U, recipe screen, bookmarks, cheat mode and config screen work, and its + button moves a recipe into the crafting grid or a station; mods' own categories (Tech Reborn's 25) and Just Enough Breeding's mobs draw.
note: Tried on Linux only; macOS, Windows and a LAN game have not run it. JEI needs the mod Mezz Config GUI for its config screen.
